title: Akiyama Mizuki — Cuteness For You〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: After school
Kamiyama High School - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I ended up having to stay the entire day because of all those tests I had to take...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Going to school takes so much stamina.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Once I get home, I think I'll nap until 25:00 rolls around...
Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's Ena.
Hey, Ena!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Mizuki? I didn't know you were at school today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I had a bunch of tests to take, so they said I had to come. Guess what? I've been here since this morning!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Ena, you're here super early. Is there something you need to do?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sort of...
I have to get this worksheet done.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A worksheet?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's due today, yeah. I put it on my desk when I got it and then totally forgot about it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So, I had to get up early...
This sucks.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh...
You're weirdly dutiful when it comes to these sorts of things, huh.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's so weird about it, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, I just remembered.
There's something I've been meaning to give you. One sec...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here, it's this. Want it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, that's... A coupon for that cosmetics shop! But why me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I got it at the mall. I figured since I had to leave the house early anyway, I might as well stop by and do some shopping.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'd already bought everything I needed, and you said the other day that you were running low.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You remembered?
Thanks, I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I might just go and grab what I need on my way home today♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sounds like a plan to me. Especially since that coupon's going to expire pretty soon.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Anyway, I need to head inside.
See you later on Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay. Bye bye!
se_walk_women_001_1
Several dozen minutes later
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Man, I couldn't resist buying all those other new things besides the eye shadow I needed.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I even got some free samples, so I'll give those to Ena as thanks for the coupon...)
Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_women_001_2
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Kanade? Mafuyu?!
What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm on my way home from school. Kanade was just visiting the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
We ran into each other a little bit ago.
Then, we saw you just now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, wow!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Today's really feeling like my lucky day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Lucky?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, guess what? I ran into Ena earlier! Which means I got the full N25 set today!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That means I'm pretty lucky, right?
I mean, it's so rare to see all of you outside like this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, that is rare...
I understand why it feels special. Especially since it's by complete coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade hardly ever leaves her house to begin with.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Too true!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Are you two going somewhere after this?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... We need to buy some daily necessities, yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
At the supermarket by your house.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, I guess it's bye bye for now!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes.
But we'll see you later on Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: See you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup!
See you later on Nightcord!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really wasn't expecting to run into everyone like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If it gets me days like these...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Maybe it's not so bad stopping in to school every once in a while.)
